import { AbstractShader } from '@/core/materials/shaders/AbstractShader'

  uAsteroidGradients: Texture | null
  lightPosition: Vector3
  uRockColor: Color
  uColorJitter: number
  uMariaStrength: number
  uSpecularStrength: number

  uDetailScale: number

  uDetailAverageArm: Vector3
  uDetailSaturation: number
  uDetailBrightness: number
  uDetailNormalScale: number
  uDetailAoInfluence: number
  uDetailRoughInfluence: number
  uTintStrength: number
  uSurfaceAmbient: number
  uDustColor: Color
  uDustDensity: number
  uDustScaleHeight: number
  uDustRingInner: number
  uDustRingOuter: number
  uDustCamRingPos: Vector3
  uDustLightDirRing: Vector3
  uDustAnglePower: number
  uDustNearFade: number
  uDustPlanetRadius: number
  uDustRadialMap: Texture | null
  uDustRadialMapScale: number
  uRingBandMap: Texture | null
  uRingBandEnabled: number
  uBandMeanColor: Vector3
  uBandTintStrength: number
  uLayerHalfThickness: number
  uLayerShadowStrength: number
  uOriginOffset: Vector3
  uShapeAmpMin: number
  uShapeAmpMax: number
  uShapeFreq: number
  uSpinPeriod: number
  uSpinTime: number
  uFreshnessBrighten: number
  uCavityShade: number
  uLunarMix: number
  uOppositionSurge: number
  uPlanetshineColor: Color
  uPlanetshineStrength: number
  uRingshineStrength: number
  uRingBandSrgb: number
  uIceFraction: number
  uIceRockColor: Color
  uIceSpecularStrength: number
  uIceSpecularPower: number
  uIceSpecularTint: number
  uIceLunarMix: number
  uIceSurfaceAmbient: number
}

class InstancedAsteroidShader extends AbstractShader<keyof InstancedAsteroidUniforms> {
  public constructor(options: InstancedAsteroidShaderOptions = {}) {
    super({ ...Shader, ...instancedAsteroidShaderSource(options) })

    this.uniforms = {
      uAsteroidGradients: new Uniform(null),
      lightPosition: new Uniform(new Vector3()),
      uRockColor: new Uniform(new Color(0x6b6157)),
      uColorJitter: new Uniform(0.12),
      uMariaStrength: new Uniform(0.3),
      uSpecularStrength: new Uniform(0.05),
      uSpecularPower: new Uniform(8.0),
      uSpecularTint: new Uniform(0.0),
      // Фотограмметрический PBR-микрослой (см. чанк TriplanarDetail); enabled 0 —
      // текстуры не загрузились, слой выключен
      uRockDiffMap: new Uniform(null),
      uRockNorMap: new Uniform(null),
      uRockArmMap: new Uniform(null),
      uDetailMapsEnabled: new Uniform(0),
      uDetailScale: new Uniform(1),
      uImpostorReady: new Uniform(0),
      uLodVolumetric: new Uniform(0),
      uDetailStartFraction: new Uniform(0.75),
      uDetailAverageDiffuse: new Uniform(new Vector3(1, 1, 1)),
      uDetailAverageArm: new Uniform(new Vector3(1, 1, 0)),
      uDetailSaturation: new Uniform(0.35),
      uDetailBrightness: new Uniform(1.6),
      uDetailNormalScale: new Uniform(1),
      uDetailAoInfluence: new Uniform(0.8),
      uDetailRoughInfluence: new Uniform(0.7),
      uTintStrength: new Uniform(0.25),
      uSurfaceAmbient: new Uniform(0.03),
      uDustColor: new Uniform(new Color(0x9b968c)),
      uDustDensity: new Uniform(0),
      uDustScaleHeight: new Uniform(1),
      uDustRingInner: new Uniform(0),
      uDustRingOuter: new Uniform(1e9),
      uDustCamRingPos: new Uniform(new Vector3()),
      uDustLightDirRing: new Uniform(new Vector3(1, 0, 0)),
      uDustAnglePower: new Uniform(2),
      uDustNearFade: new Uniform(1),
      uDustPlanetRadius: new Uniform(0),
      // Радиальный профиль пыли из альфы текстуры кольца; scale 0 — выключен
      uDustRadialMap: new Uniform(null),
      uDustRadialMapScale: new Uniform(0),
      // Полосы кольца и слой (см. чанк RingDust): выключены, пока система не отдаст текстуру
      uRingBandMap: new Uniform(null),
      uRingBandEnabled: new Uniform(0),
      uBandMeanColor: new Uniform(new Vector3(1, 1, 1)),
      uBandTintStrength: new Uniform(1),
      uLayerHalfThickness: new Uniform(1),
      uLayerShadowStrength: new Uniform(0.25),

      // не пишут — 0 и все выражения вершинника тождественны прежним
      uOriginOffset: new Uniform(new Vector3()),
      uShapeAmpMin: new Uniform(0),
      uShapeAmpMax: new Uniform(0),
      uShapeFreq: new Uniform(1),
      // Вращение камня: период (сек. сцены, 0 — выкл), время (сек. сцены,
      // отдельный от прочих юниформ времени движка — см. AsteroidRingSystem)
      uSpinPeriod: new Uniform(0),
      uSpinTime: new Uniform(0),
      // Запечённые атрибуты породы (см. чанк AsteroidShape / ArchetypeShape.surfaceAt):
      // свежий скол разлома светлее/глаже, днища кратерных чаш затенены
      uFreshnessBrighten: new Uniform(0.15),
      uCavityShade: new Uniform(0.5),
      // Модель освещения камня (см. чанк AsteroidBrdf): реголит + planetshine
      uLunarMix: new Uniform(0.8),
      uOppositionSurge: new Uniform(0.3),
      uPlanetshineColor: new Uniform(new Color(0xb8ad9c)),
      uPlanetshineStrength: new Uniform(1.5),
      uRingshineStrength: new Uniform(0),
      uRingBandSrgb: new Uniform(0),
      // Ледяная примесь (см. чанк AsteroidIce): доля 0 — все тела базового
      // профиля; ручки заполняет AsteroidRingSystem из ледяного профиля
      uIceFraction: new Uniform(0),
      uIceRockColor: new Uniform(new Color(0xc4d2dc)),
      uIceSpecularStrength: new Uniform(0.5),
      uIceSpecularPower: new Uniform(12.0),
      uIceSpecularTint: new Uniform(0.0),
      uIceLunarMix: new Uniform(0.5),
      uIceSurfaceAmbient: new Uniform(0.06)
    }
    this.name = 'InstancedAsteroidShader'
  }
}

export { InstancedAsteroidShader }

# Asteroid noise performance investigation plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans inline on the existing authorized audit branch. One fresh final review for this stage.

**Goal:** Identify and, if verified, remove redundant gradient construction in the expensive Near asteroid draw without changing detail or images.

**Architecture:** First compare the installed procedural simplex functions with a temporary lookup of the exact finite gradients already used by dust. Isolate vertex and fragment substitutions on the real built materials. Keep shader math after gradient construction, all geometry, LOD and quality settings unchanged. Keep the original material path and independently compare frozen images; do not ship a failed candidate.

**Tech stack:** Installed Three0.182, TypeScript/GLSL, Vite production preview, native Chrome GPU timers, Vitest/Playwright if application code changes.

**Spec:** Continuing user authorization to fix audit findings and optimize Alkaid/W26 without quality degradation; docs/project-audit-2026-10-21.md item16, GPU draw attribution and volume-batching evidence. Hypothesis: the repeated simplex permutation/gradient construction in vertex deformation and fragment surface noise contributes materially to Near time; a finite exact-gradient lookup may reduce it. This hypothesis is not an accepted optimization yet.

## Global constraints

- BASE c00a4de416befd402c3587ccb31e7f2a24e05a1d; current branch codex/audit-fixes-2026-10-21. Local commit only; no automatic push.
- Reuse the immutable current cloud production build volume-batch-dist-2026-10-27 after verifying all32files and matching current application/test inputs. Prior artifacts remain unchanged.
- No lower detail, density, resolution, samples, texture quality or changed noise field. No new dependency.
- Temporary material shader/uniform patches must restore exactly; borrowed dust gradient texture remains owned by its existing material. No persistent production coupling to dust is allowed if implementation follows.
- Run GPU/heavy test jobs serially. Poll GPU queries only after measurements. Keep raw evidence, rejected variants and failures.
- Native exact HDR/depth/final-image parity and useful measured improvement are the acceptance gates. If either fails, document and reject the candidate; no fabricated speedup.

## Review focus

1. Permutation wrapping, simplex corners and GLSL float arithmetic: retain original skew/kernel/order; compare actual images before/after and independent original noise on random/boundary points if accepted.
2. Vertex displacement precision and log depth: frozen production images plus explicit depth/HDR tests must guard an implementation.
3. Shared Near/L0 materials, per-object callbacks and existing texture ownership: record actual consumers, restore shader/uniform state and observe menu resource counters.
4. GPU timing provenance and intervention overhead: native production build only; no source-module imports, warmed alternating variants, recorded instance counts and stage-specific timings.
5. Cross-driver/active-scenario/lifecycle limits: do not claim universal parity; if shipping, add native+SwiftShader tests, resource reuse/copy/context checks and full existing suites.

### Task 1: Diagnose simplex lookup on the production asteroid materials

**Files:**
- Create ignored benchmark-results/heavy-scenes/asteroid-noise-2026-10-27.browser.js and run-asteroid-noise-2026-10-27.mjs.
- Reuse read-only gpu-draws-2026-10-27.browser.js connection/scenario/camera/timer methods.
- Create docs/benchmarks/asteroid-noise-2026-10-27.json and update docs/project-audit-2026-10-21.md after verified results.
- If an optimization passes both gates, extend this plan with exact implementation/test interfaces and RED/GREEN cases before editing production files.

**Interfaces:** Diagnostic connect(runtimeUrl), experiment(options) on existing DI services/materials. No application API change in diagnosis.

- [x] Extract exact snoise(vec3)/snoiseGrad bodies from compiled material sources, replace only permutation/gradient construction with the proven dust lookup math. Probe fails loudly when anchors, native GPU, geometry materials or gradient texture are absent. Record sources and actual relevant uniforms.
- [x] Run baseline-vs-identical control followed by isolated vertex, isolated fragment and combined candidate, frozen engine/time/history/camera. Save candidate/control RGBA8 and HDR/depth where available; report differences, never hide them. Warm programs before timing and use separate Near/L0 draw queries and full RenderPass scopes.
  Expected: control exact; candidate outcome is evidence, not predetermined. Missing capability/control before implementation is the diagnostic RED gate if a shipping candidate follows.
- [x] Native smoke on Alkaid, then both Alkaid/W26 and additional frozen camera view. At least two variant orders for performance. Validate source/build identity, frame counts/query ranges, diagnostics and restoration.
  Expected: complete measurements with explicit acceptance/rejection per candidate, no shader/WebGL/resource errors.
- [x] For an accepted candidate, first add a production capability regression that fails on current material plus native independent-function/image tests. Extend plan and implement minimal owned-resource path; run relevant and full typecheck/unit/lint/build/native checks and paired final production validation. If rejected, do not edit application code or repeat unchanged full suites; archive diagnosis instead.
- [x] Archive raw reports, sources, logs, manifests and limitations; recalculate statistics and verify evidence hashes. One fresh read-only final review, rule on all declined boundaries, local commit, preserve then remove only this plan's scratch workspace.

Self-review: one hypothesis with stage isolation, one coupled diagnostic task; no shared task interfaces. Prior indexing/culling/zero-amplitude work is already retained. No new shader or quality change is presumed safe because the dust lookup previously worked in a different stage.

## Conditional implementation detail (execute only after the full diagnostic gate)

Preferred candidate is fragment-only: vertex lookup increases L0 cost and complicates displacement precision for a small extra Near gain. Confirm both scenes and orders before accepting.

- Extract the existing exact table factory and scalar lookup GLSL into `src/core/materials/shaders/lib/SimplexGradientLookup.ts`. Expose `createSimplexGradientTexture(name: string)` and `simplexNoiseLookupFunctions(noiseName: string, uniformName: string, permutationName: string)` for trusted internal GLSL identifiers. Keep the dust wrapper's factory/name and generated GLSL byte-identical, verified independently against BASE; this is code reuse, not shared texture ownership.
- InstancedAsteroidShaderTemplate replaces only its fragment `noiseFunctions` include with scalar lookup GLSL (`snoise`, `uAsteroidGradients`, `asteroidLookupPermute`). Vertex source and global Noise.ts stay byte-identical. Add null sampler uniform to InstancedAsteroidShader; InstancedAsteroidMaterial creates its own texture and owns it through copy/clone/dispose, including dispose/reupload. Self-copy must preserve the resource.
- RED: material lifecycle tests exercise real dispose events/independent ownership; browser fixture requires the owned lookup and its active linked uniform, then compares the installed scalar function against original procedural GLSL on random/negative/period-boundary inputs and the real material against original fragment noise in HDR/depth images. Missing material capability must fail before implementation.
- GREEN: minimal implementation, focused unit/native tests. GPU fixture checks reuse, context restoration and clone/source disposal independently. Use existing dust independent-function fixture to guard extraction. Exact material image gates (including ice variants, deformation, fading/detail and requested0/4/8samples), function error <=4e-6 matching existing dust portable bound. Exact frozen real-scene images remain mandatory; tolerance on isolated float noise is not permission for image changes.
- Run full typecheck/unit, lint, cloud production build, full native browser suite, targeted SwiftShader regression serially. Preserve logs/results before later runs overwrite output.
- Final production: new immutable build, native actual shipped material versus original procedural fragment function; fresh own texture (never borrow dust), original vertex, frozen HDR/depth/RGBA before/after controls, stationary and moving paired GPU windows with alternating order. Report draw and full frame scopes separately; menu counters must reset.
- Archive all accepted/rejected evidence, quantify resource cost, update audit, one final fresh reviewer, local commit. No quality reduction or performance inference from unit tests.

Outcome: rejected after the conditional implementation's independent native material image gate. Both candidate snapshots retained; all application/test changes reverted. Exact diagnostic images on two scenes were insufficient to establish parity on broader material inputs. No candidate build/full-suite/moving validation was run after rejection. Archive and one final review remain the completion gate.
